newsitem.title: UK: Psion appoints new finance director.
newsitem.headline: Psion appoints new finance director.

text.p: Psion Plc said it had appointed Marina Wyatt as finance director to succeed Mike Langley who is leaving the company.
The company said In a statement that Wyatt would join the board immediately.
Wyatt has been group financial controller at Psion since she joined the company in 1994.
Psion chairman and chief executive David Potter said he was confident Wyatt was "the right person to lead the finance function" of the company.
He paid tribute to Langley, who has worked for the company for 11 years.
Psion develops and markets personal computers, modems and applications software.
